column3: NKJV renders רַדְנוּ (“roam freely,” radnu) as “We are lords.”
Close to the Hebrew; “sashes” is rendered “attire.”
Close to the Hebrew; “how you make good” is rendered “Why do you beautify.”
Close to the Hebrew; “not in breaking in did you find them” is rendered “I have not found it by secret search, But plainly.”
Close to the Hebrew; “treat lightly” is rendered “gad about.”
Close to the Hebrew; “objects of your confidence” is rendered “your trusted allies.”
